notes.title: Red pipes update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857128/558f8d79f832a432b059f643e612667a7758682f.png[/img]

We heard you and created an update that will hopefully fulfill all your dreams :)

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Version 1.1: red pipes

[h2]New features and additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]QWRkZWQgb25lIG1vcmUgcHV6emxl[/b]
[*] The Host can skip the intro animation by pressing "ESC".
[*] A sound for the radios was added in the tutorial room.
[*] Added a sound for the machine reset to clarify the puzzle.
[*] Added a new save point "The machine".
[*] Removed "???" point from main menu.
[*] Added info about new game in the main menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857128/0e52fb329e2c4aa424d3aa64271ede39bedaead2.png[/img]
[h2]Gameplay/Visual changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] improve air control mid jump by 500%.
[*] Removed collision of pit pillars, the puzzle is not a jumping one :)
[*] Move respawn point from the pit to the end of the pit when puzzle solved.
[*] Added slight color correction.
[*] The phone is a liar.
[*] Change the text color in the level selection screen to clarify it.
[*] Slightly reworked main menu room.
[*] Slightly reworked the 3rd central room.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug where the player cursor dot was not visible in the game.
[*] Fixed that sometimes only the host would get the achievements. Now both should get them.
[*] Fix that mouse cursor was sometimes visible ingame.
[*] Removed collision from "Go puzzle".
[*] Fix bug where you could spawn randomly inside the floor when starting a game. (Hopefully)
[*] Fixed a bug where you could see the highlighted interactable object from the other player.
[*] Fix bug where the calculated solution to a puzzle was not solvable.
[*] Fixed a bug where you can fall through the floor.
[*] Fixed the last thief room to avoid light spilling.
[*] Moved chair in central living room to avoid getting stuck.
[*] Moved barrel in thief movie studio room to avoid getting stuck.
[/list]
